user_goal: Keep the active-run picker inside the Plotkeeper viewport and keep Run Detail below the execution board at every supported window width.

authority.verbatim_text:
Okay,  so this is good!

Still af ew things we have to fix...

notice the drop down goes absolutely BALISTIC (it actually stretches across multiple screens!)

And if you stretch the window out further, run detail moves its little ass up above everything!

baseline.protection_evidence: clean single main worktree matching origin/main before mutation
baseline.selection_reason: Exact deployed source exhibiting both screenshot-reported responsive defects.

semantic_changes: Replace the viewport-unbounded native run menu with an accessible project-grouped picker whose popup stays within its containing viewport and handles long labels.
Keep Run Detail in document order as a full-width section below the execution board at all supported viewport widths.
Add static and real-browser responsive regression proof for the reported failures.
No API, run enrollment, filtering, selection identity, task data, release, hook, skill, ledger, or project-repository behavior changes.
No fixed viewport-specific width, horizontal page scroll, option-data truncation, hidden project grouping, or relocation of Run Detail above/beside Workstreams.
No production publication or version change in this contract.

invariants: Run selection remains exact by run ID and grouped by project.
Keyboard and pointer users can open, navigate, select, and dismiss the picker with truthful ARIA state.
Long run labels remain readable inside the bounded menu without increasing document scroll width.
Run Detail follows the complete execution board in DOM and visual order at mobile, tablet, laptop, and desktop widths.
Existing dashboard, API, task filtering, tabs, and mobile behavior remain green.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Opening a project-grouped run picker containing very long task labels stays within the visible dashboard width and keeps labels usable.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: The open menu or page stretches across multiple screens or creates horizontal scrolling.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: Pointer and keyboard users at 375, 768, 1024, and 1440 CSS-pixel widths.

acceptance_cases.promised_behavior: Run Detail renders below the complete Workstreams board at every supported width.
acceptance_cases.forbidden_behavior: Run Detail rises into a desktop side column beside or above board content.
acceptance_cases.target_and_actor: Dashboard users resizing from mobile through wide desktop.

proof_requirements.claim: A real open picker with long labels has no element or document width beyond the viewport and supports keyboard dismissal/selection.
proof_requirements.required_environment: live local dashboard with representative long active-run labels
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: browser geometry, interaction, screenshot, and console checks at required widths
proof_requirements.expected_observation: menu bounds are inside the viewport, document scrollWidth equals clientWidth, grouping remains visible, and interactions work

proof_requirements.claim: Browser geometry proves Run Detail top is not above the bottom of the execution board at every required width.
proof_requirements.command_or_read_only_check: responsive element bounding-box assertions plus screenshots
proof_requirements.expected_observation: inspector top is at or below board bottom with no relevant console errors

review_requirements.required_role: independent responsive frontend reviewer using real browser evidence

release_requirements.required_receipt: validated local-only responsive fix receipt; publication requires a separate release contract

stop_conditions: Unexpected diff, API/identity behavior change, inaccessible picker, horizontal overflow, incorrect section order, failed static/full test, browser console error, foreign listener, or mutation outside the allowed paths.
known_discrepancies: The browser-native select popup expands to the longest option and is not reliably constrained by select element CSS.
The 48rem desktop media query changes main to two columns, placing Run Detail beside the board.
The current live 0.1.6 dashboard exhibits both defects shown in the user screenshots.

requirement_trace.authority: The dropdown must not stretch across multiple screens
Run Detail must not move above or beside the execution board when widened
